title: Identification of biomarkers associated with pediatric asthma using machine learning algorithms: A review.
authors: Lin, Kexin; Wang, Yijie; Li, Yongjun; Wang, Youpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文用WGCNA和机器学习识别儿童哮喘生物标志物基因，纯基因表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pediatric asthma is a complex disease with a multifactorial etiology. The identification of biomarkers associated with pediatric asthma can provide insights into the pathogenesis of the disease and aid in the development of novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies. This study aimed to identify potential biomarkers for pediatric asthma using Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) and machine learning algorithms. We obtained gene expression data from publicly available databases and performed WGCNA to identify gene co-expression modules associated with pediatric asthma. We then used machine learning algorithms, including random forest, lasso regression algorithm, and support vector machine-recursive feature elimination, to classify asthma cases and controls based on the identified gene modules. We also performed functional enrichment analyses to investigate the biological functions of the identified genes.We detected 24,544 genes exhibiting differential expression between controlled and uncontrolled genes from the GSE135192 dataset. In the combined WCGNA analysis, a total of 104 co-expression genes were screened, both controlled and uncontrolled. After screening, 11 hub genes were identified. They were AK2, PDK4, PER3, GZMH, NUMBL, NRL, SCO2, CREBZF, LARP1B, RXFP1, and VDAC3P1. The areas under their receiver operating characteristic curve were above 0.78. Our study identified potential biomarkers for pediatric asthma using WGCNA and machine learning algorithms. Our findings suggest that 11 hub genes could be used as novel diagnostic markers and treatment targets for pediatric asthma. These findings provide new insights into the pathogenesis of pediatric asthma and may aid in the development of novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 儿童哮喘是一种具有多因素病因的复杂疾病。识别与儿童哮喘相关的生物标志物可为该疾病的发病机制提供见解，并有助于开发新的诊断和治疗策略。本研究旨在利用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和机器学习算法识别儿童哮喘的潜在生物标志物。我们从公共数据库中获取基因表达数据，并进行WGCNA以识别与儿童哮喘相关的基因共表达模块。随后，我们使用机器学习算法，包括随机森林、lasso回归算法和支持向量机-递归特征消除，基于所识别的基因模块对哮喘病例和对照组进行分类。我们还进行了功能富集分析，以探究所识别基因的生物学功能。我们从GSE135192数据集中检测到24,544个在受控与未受控基因间差异表达的基因。在合并的WGCNA分析中，共筛选出104个共表达基因，涵盖受控与未受控状态。筛选后，鉴定出11个枢纽基因，分别为AK2、PDK4、PER3、GZMH、NUMBL、NRL、SCO2、CREBZF、LARP1B、RXFP1和VDAC3P1。其受试者工作特征曲线下面积均高于0.78。我们的研究通过WGCNA和机器学习算法识别了儿童哮喘的潜在生物标志物。研究结果表明，这11个枢纽基因可作为儿童哮喘的新型诊断标志物和治疗靶点。这些发现为儿童哮喘的发病机制提供了新的见解，并可能有助于开发新的诊断和治疗策略。
